title: Live-review rows submitted DIRECT to the VM (POST /api/bot/live-review/rows, TRADE-ACTION-DIRECT-PATH phase 2) are not mirrored into comms/live_review/rows/ or reviews.jsonl, so every reader of the rows (graders, performance review, coverage counts) misses them
note:
Filed 2026-11-19 by AM-OPS-8 from the manager's correction.
MEASURED: the VM's live_review_rows_watch log (diag log_file, 827 records 10-26..11-19, read_state complete) holds 99 records with source=direct that appear in no row file.
Example: SLV pkg-2616d7fbc5134e2e, reviewed direct 11-18 14:37Z and 18:03Z (hold). The VM returned 409 'already handled' to a later reviewer.
Impact: my own rows-only coverage join reported 16 missed real-money/prop reviews this week. With the direct records the true count is 0. Any rows-only reader is undercounting.
Fix direction: mirror direct rows into the same rows store (live-review-rows-mirror), or make every reader union the watch log. Pick one store; no second path.
Done when: a direct row appears in comms/live_review/reviews.jsonl within one mirror cycle.
